subtitle: Last Sunday after Trinity
collect: Merciful God, teach us to be faithful in change and uncertainty, that trusting in your word and obeying your will we may enter the unfailing joy of Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.

notices.title: Monday evening Bible study
paragraphs: The Monday evening Bible study group meets at Westhumble Chapel. Please contact Amanda on aewadsworth@hotmail.com if you would like more information about joining this group.

notices.title: The Alpha course
paragraphs: The Alpha course meets in The Ranmore Room (the vestry).

notices.title: Thursday morning Bible study
notices.when: Thursday 29 October · 11am for an 11.30am start, until 12.30pm
paragraphs: The Thursday morning Bible Study group meets at Westhumble Chapel. If you would like to join this group, please email admin@micklehamchurch.org.uk or call Alison Wood on 01372 376443 or 07905 985928.

notices.title: Memorial service
paragraphs: Memorial Service in church for the late Kirsten von Wedel.

notices.title: Chapel Farm Macmillan Coffee Morning
paragraphs: At Chapel Farm, Chapel Lane, Westhumble, RH5 6AY. This is a lovely occasion hosted annually by Liz and John Absalom and everyone is welcome.
If you are unable to come along on the day but wish to support the event, there is a QR code link to the JustGiving page for the coffee morning on page 21 of the October Parish Magazine.

notices.title: Worship for All & Shoe Box Sunday
paragraphs: Worship for All in church and Shoe Box Sunday. We will be collecting Shoe boxes for Link to Hope again this year so look out for the leaflets giving more information which are at the back of church.

notices.title: Celebration of the life of Barry Moughton
paragraphs: There will be a service of celebration for the life of the late Barry Moughton at St Michael’s Church followed by a family Burial of Ashes in the churchyard. The service will be zoomed for those who would like to join virtually.

notices.title: Compline
paragraphs: Please note the 24th is a later date. Compline in church. All are welcome to come along for a short service and period of reflection, prayer and fellowship.

notices.title: Coffee and cake at the Chapel
paragraphs: Coffee and cake at the Chapel in Westhumble. Only £2 and free drinks for children. Do come along and bring a friend or neighbour. Offers of homemade cakes or help on the morning appreciated. Contact Jonathan Blake: 07787 126966.

notices.title: Remembrance Sunday
paragraphs: Service in church for Remembrance Sunday, with Act of Remembrance around the war memorial at 11am. Afterwards we have kindly been invited to have refreshments at RGS-Surrey Hills. There will not be an 8am Communion service at the Chapel on this Sunday.

Poppies will be available to buy in church from Sunday 25 October onwards. Payment can be made by cash or there is a QR code which connects directly to the collection being made in Mickleham and Westhumble for the Royal British Legion.

notices.title: A Concert for Remembrance Sunday
paragraphs: A Concert for Remembrance Sunday by Mickleham Choral Society in church. Tickets £15, children 12 years and under £7.50. Book tickets via Events page on www.micklehamchoral.org.uk. More information on page 6 of the October Parish Magazine.
notices.emphasis: Please note that the venue is incorrect in the magazine: the concert will be in St Michael’s Church, not the Village Hall.

notices.title: PCC meeting
paragraphs: The PCC meets in the Ranmore Room.

notices.title: Lights to Remember
paragraphs: Lights to Remember service in church, when we will remember our loved ones whom we have lost. See invitation attached to covering email.

notices.title: Ascending Deeper
paragraphs: Ascending Deeper evening on the topic of What does the Bible say about Migration? Please let Sandra know if you wish to come or want any information.

notices.title: Children’s Christmas Concert: The Snowman
paragraphs: There is a Children’s Christmas Concert ‘The Snowman’ in church followed by the lighting of the Christmas Trees outside the church and refreshments provided by the Church Community Group. There will be more information in the November Parish Magazine.
notices.emphasis: Please note that the Christingle Craft Workshop and Family Service will be on Sunday, 6 December.

notices.title: Autumn Soup Lunch
paragraphs: Autumn Soup Lunch in Mickleham Village Hall. Please make a note in your diaries of this remaining date of these popular lunches. Delicious homemade soups, bread and cheese and good company. No charge but donations gratefully received, with all proceeds going to local charities (including the Foodbank).
To help with numbers, please book your place with Andy Diamond by calling 07789 775354 or email him at adiamond714@gmail.com or sign the list at the back of the church.

pumpkins: All of the wonderful PUMPKINS which have added colour to the church for Harvest will need to be removed by this Sunday, 25 October. Please would you help by taking away one or more pumpkins to beautify your home or for carving or cooking. We would be very grateful.

foodbank.intro: Thank you so much for your continued kindness and support. Here are some suggested items that are needed this week:
foodbank.donations: You can also drop donations off in Church on Sunday morning, at the monthly Chapel Coffee morning (10am to 12noon) at The Stepping Stones, or at any time at any of the usual locations in Mickleham and Westhumble, details in the Parish Magazine.

clock.title: Clocks go back
clock.text: Set your clocks back an hour this Sunday.
